title: Foul Play
author: Charles Reade · Dion Boucicault
description: "Foul Play" by Charles Reade and Dion Boucicault is a dramatic novel written during the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The book centers around the lives of two families, the Wardlaws and the Penfolds, as it delves into themes of trust, betrayal, and the consequences of a single mistake.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Reade · Dion Boucicault (1814–1884) wrote Foul Play. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
